description: Reconciliation fixtures for CMS-HCC V28 PY2026. Expected values are the deterministic output of hccinfhir==0.1.5 for each scenario. These lock in the contract between the RAF engine and its coefficient provider: any drift flips the test red. When CMS ships its official Python reference software (early 2026), replace the expected values with the CMS reference output and tighten the tolerance to 1e-4.
